people.name: Titus
people.line: Gentile convert and companion of Paul

translations.web: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.
translations.bsb: So we urged Titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.
translations.kjv: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would ➔ also finish in you the same grace also.
translations.asv: Insomuch that we exhorted Titus, that as he made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace also.
